patch_description: Improve the ranked_polish local search in two ways. First, per the recommendation, use a staged tolerance for collecting near-binding constraints: start with a broad band (10% of dmin/dmax) so many potentially-binding pairs are perturbed early (escaping local optima cheaply), then tighten to 2% for precision as improvements accumulate. Second, add deterministic pair-axis moves — pushing the current closest pair apart and pulling the diameter pair together along their connecting axis — before the random-direction perturbations, since these are the highest-quality first-order moves for the exact ratio objective. This is cheap, monotone (strict improvements only), and increases the chance of squeezing out extra ratio beyond the current plateau at ~1.00.
